description.en: A list of cloud phone instance IDs.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。不超过 100 个字符。
description.en: A client-generated token, up to 100 characters long, that ensures the idempotency of the request.

description.zh: 从指定的云手机文件路径拉取文件。
description.en: The path of the file or folder to fetch from the cloud phone.

description.zh:
从OSS拉取文件的服务域名。

> 当云手机和OSS Bucket处于相同地域，域名可填写内网域名，加快传输速率，不产生公网网络费用，杭州为例： `oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com` 。具体的域名列表映射可参考[OSS地域和访问域名](~~31837~~)。
description.en:
The endpoint for uploading files to OSS.

> If the cloud phone and the destination OSS bucket are in the same region, you can use an internal endpoint to accelerate the transfer and avoid public network charges. For example, in the China (Hangzhou) region, use `oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com`. For a complete list of endpoints, see [OSS regions and endpoints](~~31837~~).

description.zh:
保存拉取文件的存储类型。

> 目前仅支持的云端存储类型是OSS对象存储。
description.en:
The type of storage service for the fetched file.

> Currently, only Object Storage Service (OSS) is supported.

description.zh:
从OSS拉取文件的云端地址。

> 可使用的OSS桶名，必须以“cloudphone-saved-bucket-”前缀的Bucket桶，例如“cloudphone-saved-bucket-example”，并创建OSS文件夹作为备份目录。UploadUrl的拼写规则是“oss://”+“桶名”+“/”+“文件夹名称”。
description.en:
The destination URL in OSS.

> The destination bucket name must be prefixed with `cloudphone-saved-bucket-`. For example, `cloudphone-saved-bucket-example`. You must also create a folder in the bucket to serve as the destination directory. The `UploadUrl` must follow the format: `oss://<bucket_name>/<folder_name>`.

descriptions.zh: 目前仅支持将云手机的文件或文件夹拉取到OSS对象存储服务。
descriptions.en: This operation fetches only files or folders from a cloud phone to Object Storage Service.
